fields.summary_ko.0: ASML, the monopoly supplier of EUV lithography systems, recorded 12-month revenue of $43.4B (+22.5% YoY) and net profit of $14.8B with a 34.1% net margin.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix (SKHY) recorded 12-month revenue of $201.2B (+219.8% YoY) and net profit of $141.4B with a 70.3% net margin, the largest beneficiary of AI memory supply shortage.
